arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِـ (فُلَانٍ) [بِاسْمِهِ]، وَارْفَعْ دَرَجَتَهُ فِي الْمَهْدِيِّينَ، وَاخْلُفْهُ فِي عَقِبِهِ فِي الْغَابِرِينَ، وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَلَهُ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ، وَافْسَحْ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ، وَنَوِّرْ لَهُ فِيهِ.
transliteration: Allahummaghfir li (name of the person), warfa' darajatahu fil-mahdiyyeen, wakhlufhu fee 'aqibihi fil-ghaabireen, waghfir lanaa wa lahu yaa rabbal-'aalameen, wafsah lahu fee qabrihi wa nawwir lahu feeh.
translation: O Allah, forgive [name of the person] and elevate his station among those who are guided. Send him along the path of those who came before, and forgive us and him, O Lord of the worlds. Enlarge for him his grave and shed light upon him in it.
